title: CAMP GX700 gravel bike
notes: Current exact-model manufacturer page supports a Toray T800 carbon thru-axle frame and fork, T700 plus T800 carbon cockpit and seatpost, Shimano GRX 1x12, approximately 10.2 kg in a small size excluding pedals and small accessories, 700x45C fitted tires, and a CNY 9,999 add-to-cart/JD purchase route. It does not publish maximum clearance, frame-only weight, bottom-bracket standard, construction process or a meaningful stiffness result.
